test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In June _________, the Reserve Bank of India published a ‘Consultative Document on Regulation of Microfinance’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** issued a consultative document concerning microfinance regulation on **June 14, 2021, **which is accessible as a PDF.
 
• The document provides an overview of the **microfinance sector in India**, detailing its evolution over the past two decades.
 
• It comprises chapters **covering Introduction, Developments in the microfinance sector, and Customer protection **concerns in the microfinance sector.
 
• One of the primary objectives of the document is to streamline the regulatory frameworks governing various regulated lenders operating within the microfinance domain.
 
• By removing most rules, except for one, the document aims to create a level playing field.
 
• Notably, it grants **Microfinance Institutions (MFIs)** the authority to determine the interest rates they levy on borrowers, albeit with the stipulation that these rates remain non-usurious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** serves as India's **central bank and regulatory authority** overseeing the Indian banking system.
 
• Operated under the ownership of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, the RBI plays a pivotal role in controlling, issuing, and managing the supply of the Indian rupee.
 
• Additionally, it supervises the nation's primary payment systems and actively works to foster economic development. In collaboration with the Indian Banks' Association, the RBI established the National Payments Corporation of India, tasked with promoting and regulating payment and settlement systems across the country.
 
• Furthermore, the RBI created the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation as a specialized division, aimed at providing deposit insurance and credit guarantee facilities to all Indian banks.
